mapper.sql: WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.hobby_id = #{hobbyId}::integer AND r.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND r.region LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' AND r.title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS db_key, r.hobby_id, r.title, r.capacity, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, r.view_cnt, r.reg_id, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y') AS apply_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02') AS accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00'
ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS db_key, r.hobby_id, r.title, r.capacity, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y') AS apply_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02') AS accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.reg_id = #{regId} ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS db_key, r.hobby_id, r.title, r.content, r.capacity, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, r.view_cnt, r.reg_id, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y') AS apply_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02') AS accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' WHERE r.recruit_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND r.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_recruit (hobby_id, title, content, capacity, region, meet_dt, status_cd, view_cnt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{hobbyId}::integer, #{title}, #{content}, NULLIF(#{capacity}, '')::integer, NULLIF(#{region}, ''), NULLIF(#{meetDt}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{statusCd}, ''), 'RECRUIT01'), 0, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_recruit SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, capacity = NULLIF(#{capacity}, '')::integer, region = NULLIF(#{region}, ''), meet_dt = NULLIF(#{meetDt}, ''), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET view_cnt = COALESCE(view_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE recruit_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{dbKey}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT a.apply_id::TEXT AS db_key, a.recruit_id, a.user_id, a.apply_status, a.apply_memo, a.reg_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.user_id) AS nickname, sc.code_nm AS apply_status_nm, TO_CHAR(a.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit_apply a LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = a.apply_status AND sc.p_code_id = 'APPLY00' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer ORDER BY a.apply_id

SELECT a.apply_id::TEXT AS db_key, a.recruit_id, a.user_id, a.apply_status, a.apply_memo, r.title AS recruit_title, sc.code_nm AS apply_status_nm, TO_CHAR(a.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit_apply a JOIN t_recruit r ON r.recruit_id = a.recruit_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = a.apply_status AND sc.p_code_id = 'APPLY00' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.apply_id DESC
SELECT apply_id::TEXT AS db_key, recruit_id, user_id, apply_status FROM t_recruit_apply WHERE apply_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_recruit_apply (recruit_id, user_id, apply_status, apply_memo, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{recruitId}::integer, #{userId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{applyStatus}, ''), 'APPLY01'), NULLIF(#{applyMemo}, ''), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET apply_status = #{applyStatus}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE apply_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE apply_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
